submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Sb 0.1875) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0978%. EQE went up as Sb fell from 0.71 to 0.52, 0.31 and 0.19, then dropped to 0.0449% at Sb 0.142, so the peak is near Sb ~0.19. XRD at Sb 0.12, 0.19 and 0.31 shows the same rutile-type pattern (strongest peak at Q ~1.88 1/Å). Index 0 also has a weak extra low-Q peak (Q 0.80 1/Å) that may be a minor second phase.
